page: Microsoft Azure E192ds_v7 is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running up to 4.2 GHz. The virtual machine provides 192 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 96 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, supported by 480 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates 1536 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside 11339 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. The CPU features support for advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX).

Performance benchmarks place this server in the upper echelon for memory and compute scalability. It achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core testing (202,544.14) and uncached large-block read memory bandwidth (687.65 GB/sec). Database and caching throughput are exceptional, recording 252.84 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and top-tier metrics in PassMark database execution. While single-thread performance is moderate, multi-threaded tasks such as bzip3 decompression register over 1010 GB/sec.

Without discrete GPU accelerators, text generation throughput on large language models remains constrained compared to prompt processing speeds that leverage Intel AMX tiles. Storage performance is anchored by the substantial 11.3 TB NVMe array, which balances large in-memory capacities with high IOPS disk availability. The machine does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating within private or routed network topologies.

This hardware footprint delivers high qualitative resource density for large-scale enterprise deployments. Microsoft Azure E192ds_v7 is tailored for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including large in-memory databases like SAP HANA or Redis, substantial relational database engines, massive multi-threaded data analytics, and high-throughput static data pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E192ds_v7 is a memory-optimized cloud server driven by a 96-core, 192-vCPU Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 1536 GB of system memory and 11339 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage, this instance balances high memory capacity with rapid local disk I/O. Benchmark assessments demonstrate exceptional multi-core compute capability, top-tier uncached memory bandwidth at 687.65 GB/sec, and high-velocity key-value storage throughput reaching 252.84 million Redis SET operations per second. Hardware-level acceleration features such as Intel AMX and AVX-512 facilitate efficient prompt processing in matrix operations, though text generation remains bounded by the lack of discrete GPUs. The E192ds_v7 is designed for demanding memory-bound workloads, including distributed in-memory databases, large data warehousing engines, analytics, and high-concurrency enterprise transaction processing.
